counter_reasons._note: display text only (v1.3, historian-assessment.md): shown on the formation card and the replay's formation panel; no new log event. Keys are <winner id>><loser id>. The numbers are in matchup_damage_mult.
counter_reasons.tight_wedge>pincer: The column punches through a centre the enemy thinned to reach round the flanks (Austerlitz 1805, Blenheim 1704).
counter_reasons.pincer>wide_line: The flank attack rolls up a long line where it is weakest, at its open end (Leuthen 1757, Cowpens 1781).
counter_reasons.wide_line>defensive_screen: A dense, braced defence is a big target: the wider line overlaps it and pours musketry into it from front and sides.
counter_reasons.defensive_screen>tight_wedge: Steady troops waiting behind a skirmish screen break an assault column as it comes on (Bussaco 1810).

_matchup_note: matchup_damage_mult[mine][theirs] multiplies ALL damage my army deals.
